title: Shortest Bridge
statement: A map grid has exactly two islands of land cells (1), joined within each island by shared sides; everything else is water (0). Return the fewest water cells that must be filled to connect the two islands.

answerKey.pattern: Find one island with DFS, then multi-source BFS from all its cells until the other island is reached
keyPoints: Mark every cell of the first island and put them all in the queue
BFS outward through water, one layer per filled cell
The layer at which a cell of the second island appears is the answer
acceptableSlowerApproaches: BFS from every cell of the first island separately: O(n⁴)

hints: Which cells should the search start from?
All cells of one island at once: a multi-source BFS.
Expand layer by layer; the first time you step onto the other island, the number of layers minus one is the answer.
